window-1.title: Silk — Interactive Generative Art
window-1.blurb: Drag your cursor across the black and it blooms into mirrored threads of light — the rare web toy that feels hand-made and meditative rather than clever, and I think you'll lose a happy twenty minutes to it before screenshotting half of them as pattern refs.

window-4.title: The Selby — Inside Creative People's Homes
window-4.blurb: It's basically permission to let your rooms look like your brain — every shelf, taped photo and inherited lamp doing the decorating for you.

window-5.title: Cookboys, I12 Katong
window-5.blurb: It's a whole 1970s Hainanese cookboy universe built out in vintage signboards and old shopfronts — basically a persona shoot you can order kopi in, and I need you to photograph the signage before anyone else does.
